scenes.bodyText: The air in this secluded clearing is heavy with the acrid scent of brimstone and decay. Twisted, blackened briars choke the undergrowth, coiling around a half-sunken stone chest bearing ancient runic carvings.

choices.label: Inspect the stone chest
choices.tooltip: Pry open the stone lid to search for relics.

choices.label: Leave the glade
choices.tooltip: Back away from the necrotic grove.

scenes.bodyText:
With a harsh scraping sound, you push aside the mossy slab. Resting within on a bed of dry ashes is an intricately carved, heavy iron key—the Rusted Keystone!

This relic matches the ancient mechanism sealing the subterranean entrance to the Sunken Ruins.

choices.label: Take the Rusted Keystone
choices.tooltip: Add the dungeon keystone to your inventory.

scenes.bodyText: As you secure the heavy keystone in your pack, the oppressive pressure lingering over the clearing faintly diminishes. You are now prepared to unlock the inner sanctum of the Sunken Ruins.
